issues.description: The template's PersonService defines a constructor that accepts a PersonRepository (enabling Spring constructor injection), matching the intended design described in the problem statement (PersonService uses PersonRepository). The solution's PersonService replaces this constructor with a no-argument constructor that sets the final personRepository field to null. This structural change prevents normal constructor-based dependency injection and will cause NullPointerExceptions when the service methods call personRepository (and therefore contradicts the template and the intended design). Students comparing template and solution (or relying on the solution as reference) would be confused about how the repository is injected and about the correct class structure.
